neighbours.label: punctuation (colon, dash, comma) that introduces an elaboration of the preceding clause, the 'namely' slot ('unfold as life unfolds: relentlessly')
fire: The novel should end the way grief ends: slowly, quietly, and without a neat resolution.
Their findings matched our own — namely, that the bridge had been badly maintained.
Treat your savings the way you treat your health, patiently and with regular attention.
The answer from every survey was the same: people want shorter commutes above all.
Her new perfume smells like the old classic – fresh, citrusy and surprisingly light.
Build the garden the way nature builds a forest, slowly and in overlapping layers.
The two studies reached a single conclusion — that sleep loss impairs memory.
There is only one rule in this kitchen: everyone cleans up after themselves.
quiet: The novel should end slowly and quietly, without a neat resolution for anyone.
Their findings matched our own, and the bridge report was published in May.
Treat your savings patiently and check your accounts at least once a month.
Every survey was sent out in March and the answers came back in April.
Her new perfume smells fresh and citrusy and is surprisingly light to wear.
Build the garden slowly and plant the shrubs in overlapping layers each spring.
The two studies were published in the same journal in the same year.
Everyone in this kitchen cleans up after themselves before going home.

notes: near misses keep plain list commas and 'and' coordination; trigger is the punctuation token before the elaboration
